verdict.rationale: The axis applies because a government agency's public guidance site can reasonably be expected to be reachable by a keyless agent. The only direct observation (2026-10-07) is that a standard keyless client could not connect to aima.gov.pt at all: TLS certificate verification failed and nothing on the host was fetched. The probe notes that a dossier from the previous day saw an open robots.txt and a 200 landing page. However, the latest single-attempt failure means current reachability is unproven, and the error may partly reflect an incomplete certificate chain or client-side trust setup, which keeps confidence low.
